official_definition: [Six Pentan Rush (Condition: Six Pentans)] When you have six or more "Pentan" Spirits, the symbols of this Spirit become 6 Yellow symbols.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Six Pentan Rush] or [Six Pentan Rush: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Six Pentan Rush]", "give [Six Pentan Rush]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
